runs.claimBoundary: A ranking of retained catalogued galaxies under stated priors; the most probable candidate is a suggestion for follow-up, not a host identification, and a host fainter than the catalogues or outside their cones is always possible.
runs.notComputedReason: no catalogued galaxy is retained around the event (NED/SIMBAD/Gaia cones)

rules.missed: a host not in the retained catalogues counts as one candidate at f = missedFractionalOffset
rules.offset: f = separation / directional light radius (SIMBAD shape), else separation x kpc/arcsec(z) / physical scale, else separation / angular scale; term exp(-f); f > maxFractionalOffset gives 0
rules.probable: the top candidate is 'probable' when its posterior >= probablePosterior and >= probableRatio x the next hypothesis
rules.redshift: only when the transient and the candidate both have a redshift: exp(-0.5 (dz / sigma)^2), sigma^2 = sum of the stated errors^2 + floor^2

runs.claimBoundary: Retained earlier detections at the position; they show earlier variability at the position, not that the same source caused both.
runs.notComputedReason: no retained photometry more than 30 days before discovery

parameters.rule: prior activity = at least minDetections detections (S/N >= 5) on at least minNights nights more than gapDays before discovery

runs.claimBoundary: Galactic foreground extinction and a star-like Gaia source at the position; context for reading the photometry, not a classification.
